appointments_cancelled_by.name: appointments_cancelled_by
appointments_cancelled_by.value: cancelled_by IS NULL OR cancelled_by IN ('client', 'clinic', 'dentist', 'system')

appointments_hold_has_expiry.name: appointments_hold_has_expiry
appointments_hold_has_expiry.value: status <> 'hold' OR hold_expires_at IS NOT NULL

appointments_patient_required.name: appointments_patient_required
appointments_patient_required.value: status IN ('hold', 'expired') OR patient_id IS NOT NULL

phone_verifications_consumed_verified.name: phone_verifications_consumed_verified
phone_verifications_consumed_verified.value: consumed_at IS NULL OR verified_at IS NOT NULL

schedule_exceptions_extra_location.name: schedule_exceptions_extra_location
schedule_exceptions_extra_location.value: type = 'block' OR location_id IS NOT NULL
